map.活动度评估：基于 7 天日记算 CDAI，区分缓解/轻/中/重度活动: Activity assessment: compute CDAI from the 7-day diary to separate remission / mild / moderate / severe activity
map.治疗反应：治疗前后复算评分判断诱导缓解是否成功: Treatment response: recompute the score before and after treatment to judge whether induction of remission succeeded

map.算法：CDAI = 稀便次数×2 + 腹痛(0~10)×5 + 全身状况(0~1: Algorithm: CDAI = loose stools×2 + abdominal pain (0~10)×5 + general well-being (0~10)×7 + complications×20 + antidiarrheal (>0 counts as 1)×30 + abdominal mass (0/2/5)×10 + (standard Hct − measured Hct)×6 + weight deviation%×1; standard Hct is 42 for men and 37 for women. Grading: <150 remission, 150~219 mild, 220~450 moderate, >450 severe.
map.例：女性、稀便 14 次、腹痛 10 分、全身状况 7 分、并发症 1 项、无止: Example: female, 14 loose stools, abdominal pain 10, well-being 7, 1 complication, no antidiarrheal, no mass, Hct 35%, weight −5% → (37−35)=2 → CDAI = 28+50+49+20+0+0+12−5 = 154, mild activity. If male, 20 loose stools, abdominal pain 30, well-being 10, 2 complications, antidiarrheal used, mass 5, Hct 25%, weight 0% → (42−25)=17 → CDAI = 40+150+70+40+30+50+102 = 482, severe activity; hospitalization with active induction therapy is advised.
map.CDAI<150 传统定义为临床缓解，但需结合内镜下黏膜愈合（目前治疗目标）综合: CDAI<150 is traditionally defined as clinical remission, but it must be judged together with endoscopic mucosal healing (the current treatment target). Some patients develop fistulas or perianal disease while CDAI stays low and still need specialist evaluation, so follow-up must not be relaxed based on the score alone.
map.CDAI 的设计基于患者 7 天内的症状频率（稀便次数、腹痛等），以平滑单日波动: CDAI was designed around symptom frequency over 7 days (loose stool count, abdominal pain, etc.) to smooth single-day fluctuation and reflect overall activity. The more accurate the diary, the more reliable the score; short-term recall bias can overestimate or underestimate it.
